summary: Copley Acquisition Corp, a SPAC, filed an 8-K on June 10, 2026, announcing a Business Combination Agreement with Ignite Proteomics, LLC. The deal involves a Cayman-to-Delaware re-domicile, followed by a merger where SPAC Merger Sub merges into Copley, and Company Merger Sub merges into Ignite, with Pubco as the combined publicly traded entity. No specific price per share, premium, or advisors are disclosed. The filing notes that post-merger, all outstanding SPAC securities will be cancelled in exchange for Pubco securities. The transaction is subject to SPAC shareholder approval and regulatory conditions. Monitor the redemptions by SPAC shareholders and the probability of deal completion; risk-arb will focus on the redemption threshold and trust per-share value.
